sentences.text:
1  NAF  HIGH COURT OF CHHATTISGARH, BILASPUR  MCRC No. 10310 of 2022   Lalit Sidar S/o Pahaar Singh Sidar Aged About 28 Years R/o Ward No. 01,
 Ambedkar Nagar, Police Station Saraipali, District Mahasamund (C.G.)

---- Applica  Versus   State Of Chhattisgarh Through Station House Officer, Police Station  Chandrapur, District Mahasamund (C.G.)
 ---- Non-applican

For Applicant : Mr. Kamlesh Kumar Pandey, Advocate  For Non-Applicant/State : Ms. Madhunisha Singh Dy. A.G.
 Hon'ble Shri Justice Sachin Singh Rajput  Order On Board 20/02/2023 The applicant has been arrested in connection with Crime No. 141/2021 registered at Police Station - Chandrapur District - Janjgir-Champa, (C.G) for alleged commission of offence under Sections 409,
420 of IPC.
2.

Allegation against the present applicant is that while he is working as cluster manager in Ispandana finance Limited, Chandrapur he collected installment amount of loan from various person but did not deposit the same in the company thereby committed the said offence against the present applicant.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case he has not committed any crime.
He further submits that applicant is in jail since 28.06.2022, investigation is complete and the charge-sheet has been filed looking to his pretrial detention, the applicant may be released on bail.

sentences.text: 4. On the other hand, learned State counsel opposes the bail application and submits that there are statement of various witnesses have been recorded and they have stated that the applicant has received the installment amount but the same was not deposited in the finance company, looking to the allegation, applicant is not entitled for grant of bail.
5. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and considered their rival submissions.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, looking to the detention period of the applicant he is in jail since 28.06.2022, nature of allegation and trial may take some time for conclusion, without commenting anything on merits I am inclined to allow this bail application.
7.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on they furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 25,000/- along with one solvent surety for the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court on the condition that - a) He shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court.
b) He shall not act in any manner which will be prejudicial to fair and expeditious trial.

8. It is made clear that the observations made herein above is only for the purpose of deciding the bail application and the trial Court will decide the case on its own merits without being influenced by any observation made herein above.

It is also made clear that the victim/complainant or State is at liberty to move an application regarding cancellation of bail of the applicant in the event of applicant involving himself in similar offence in future or violates any of the above conditions.

Sd/-
